cross_compositor_aggregate_evaluation.rationale: Per ADR-0006 lines 45-65, an aggregate gate roll-up is selected from {CLOSED, CONDITIONAL, OPEN, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL} on the basis of independent row reports. The GNOME composite window domain is CLOSED (PASS); the KDE/KWin domain remains UNAVAILABLE due to external toolkit/compositor limitations (retained separately per ADR-0006 line 62 and not invalidating accepted CineHDR rows). Therefore, the aggregate Gate 2W roll-up status is CONDITIONAL, not OPEN.
cross_compositor_aggregate_evaluation.scope: Multi-compositor Wayland surface submission track (GNOME Shell / Mutter + KDE / KWin)

gnome_domain_evaluation.rationale: Single-session Run 7 fully satisfied all normative criteria of ADR-0004, ADR-0006 (section 3), and ADR-0007 across both backends (legacy and gpu-next). Both processes published all 4 GDK states, submitted valid Wayland color management descriptions on the composite window without error, verified FBO pixel captures with observed drift delta_max <= 0.003922 <= 0.020 and HDR distinction >= 0.247 >= 0.150, ran as isolated container instances, exited 0, and terminated CLEAN. Preliminary tolerance status was an evidentiary evaluation requirement, not a row blocker. The GNOME composite window domain is fully closed.
gnome_domain_evaluation.scope: GNOME Shell 50.5 (Mutter) on Wayland / AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (radeonsi / Mesa 26.1.6)

supersedes.reason: Reconciliation with normative ADR-0004/0006 text: eliminates retroactive KDE blocking on verified GNOME scope, recognizes 0.020 empirical validation as non-blocking, and selects normative gate statuses (CLOSED for GNOME domain, CONDITIONAL for cross-compositor aggregate).
